guidetextdraw_copy._value:
The CSU provides employees, and their eligible dependents, a choice of various medical insurance programs through the California Public Employee’s Retirement System(CalPERS). Monthly medical premiums are shared between the CSU and the employee.Coverage begins on the first day of the month after electing a health plan.

Please be advised that health premiums are paid in advance for the following month’s health benefits coverage (for example, the March pay period pays premiums for coverage from April 1-30). Therefore, please anticipate an accounts receivable to be set up for the first and/or second month premiums, as applicable.

If you have questions about your benefits or this form, please call (657) 278- 2425 or visit Total Wellness in College Park, suite CP-700.
